description: Paani ki sadi trace nazar nahin aati aur ghar tak paani sahi maatra mein nahin pahunch raha hai. Kabhi kabhi paani pura na aane se gharwalo ko bahut dikkat hoti hai. Ye samasya pichhle ek mahine se hai aur lok seva kendra par shikayat ke baad bhi koi sudhar nahin hua.
name: Archit Jaiswal
